Howdy from Hollywood

Los Angeles, California

What I do...

Animated Stories, Garden Design, & 3D Work

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]Los Angeles, California is Oddtoe’s second city hub and a launching point for most American projects and commissions. As a visual artist specializing in 3D visualization, private garden design, and animation, Hollywood and Los Angeles as a whole are a hive of activity for what Oddtoe does.

The city is home to the great animation studios like Disney, Warner Bros., Cartoon Network, and Dreamworks.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]Los Angeles also boasts 263 sunny days per year, making it an ideal environment for the sustainable and imaginative gardens, the private and public landscapes designed in Oddtoe’s studios.

Finally, there’s the practical side of the city’s economy: industrial design. Southern California is a global center of 3D design: aerospace, movie & television prop making, and additive manufacturing.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column]

Looking to collaborate from

Los Angeles, eh?

[/vc_column_text]

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]Oddtoe offers visualization and design services in Los Angeles and uses the city to service the whole of North America. Often a contracted hire or working as part of an on-site team, Oddtoe’s skill sets are used for ideation and conceptual design — all the way through to prototyping and fabrication.

Oddtoe is dedicated to transforming artistic visions into reality, capturing [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]the essence of the dreamers who made Los Angeles the global center of creativity. Oddtoe has re-imagined art and design in innovative ways. Capturing the advantages of generative AI in visual storytelling and 3D modeling, there is still a bespoke feeling to the art and design coming out of Oddtoe’s doors. 

To start a new collaboration or to inquire about availability, contact Oddtoe today.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column]
